does: Makes the given settings the manager's active module, copies them as its settings, rebuilds the load-ordered modules, clears the byte +0x150 and calls the load callbacks; the client's ecl::ModuleLoadSystem calls it first in a LoadModule

dx11 pseudo-code: builds the active module from the given settings (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x3BC5AB0 into this+0x38), copies the settings' list into this+0x1C8, rebuilds (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x3BC9AC0), stores 0 into the byte this+0x150 and answers whether this+0x68 is non-zero
